issues.span: 阿Qも、他人と口角するとき、間やその言葉を「我々は、あなたより、より大きく、あなたをどうか？」と、目を上げて言った。

payload.translation: A Q n’est pas seul un nom et une origine, et même son « chronique » n’est pas encore clair. Car les gens de Yu Gong ne se soucient qu’apporter à A Q, et seulement en lui donnant des réconforts, sans même se soucier de son « chronique ». Et bien qu’il ne l’exprime pas, il se contente d’être en face à face avec d’autres, et peut-être même se montrer avec un regard de ce genre : « Nous avons été plus grand que toi, et tu as quoi ? »

issues.span: A Q n’est pas seul un nom et une origine
issues.advice: The source says his name and native place are vague/uncertain (渺茫), not that he 'is not only a name and origin'. Render the sense of uncertainty: 'Chez Ah Q, non seulement le nom et le lieu d'origine restent flous...'

issues.span: son « chronique » n’est pas encore clair
issues.advice: 『行状』 refers to his 'record/background/antecedents', not a 'chronique'. Use something like 'son passé' or 'ses antécédents'.

issues.span: ne se soucient qu’apporter à A Q, et seulement en lui donnant des réconforts
issues.advice: Source means they only wanted him to help (只要他帮忙) and only made fun of him (只拿他玩笑). The translation invents 'réconforts' and reverses the meaning. Fix to 'ils ne voulaient que son aide et ne faisaient que se moquer de lui'.

issues.span: sans même se soucier de son « chronique »
issues.advice: Same 行状 issue; use 'son passé/ses antécédents'.

issues.span: Et bien qu’il ne l’exprime pas, il se contente d’être en face à face avec d’autres, et peut-être même se montrer avec un regard de ce genre
issues.advice: Source: 'Et Ah Q lui-même n'en parlait pas; seulement, quand il se disputait avec quelqu'un, il lui arrivait de rouler des yeux et de dire...' The translation misrenders 口角 (quarrel) and 间或 (occasionally) and invents 'se contente d'être en face à face'.

issues.span: Nous avons été plus grand que toi, et tu as quoi ?
issues.advice: Source: 'Nous étions bien plus riches que vous autrefois ! Qu'est-ce que tu es, toi ?' 阔 means wealthy/well-off, not 'grand'; and 'tu as quoi' misses '你算是什么东西' (who do you think you are / you're nothing).

issues.span: Yu Gong
issues.advice: 未庄 is a place name (Weizhuang); 'Yu Gong' is a wrong transliteration and should be 'Weizhuang'.

issues.span: ne se soucient qu’apporter à A Q
issues.advice: Grammatically incorrect French (missing 'de' and wrong construction); rewrite the clause entirely.

issues.span: il se contente d’être en face à face avec d’autres
issues.advice: Unidiomatic and unclear; express the quarrel sense naturally.

issues.span: « chronique »
issues.advice: The quoted term 行状 is a classical term for a biographical record; a literal 'chronique' is misleading in French. Use 'passé' or 'antécédents'.

issues.span: A Q est surtout nom et origine peu connue
issues.advice: The source says his name and native place are vague/uncertain (渺茫), not that he 'is' name and origin. Render as 'Bei A Q sind schon Name und Herkunft kaum bekannt' or similar.

issues.span: son « histoire » prématuré est peu connu
issues.advice: 『行状』 means his past record/background, not 'premature history'. Also 'prématuré' is a mistranslation; use 'seine frühere „Lebensgeschichte“'.

issues.span: ne se soucient qu'en aidant A Q, et seulement en lui donnant des réflexions
issues.advice: The source means they only let him help and only made fun of him (拿他玩笑 = joked at his expense), not 'giving him reflections'. Render as 'sie ließen ihn nur helfen und trieben nur Scherz mit ihm'.

issues.span: sans même s'interroger sur son « histoire »
issues.advice: Source says they never paid attention to his record (从来没有留心), which is stronger than 'without even questioning'; use 'ohne je auf seine „Lebensgeschichte“ zu achten'.

issues.span: Et bien qu'A Q ne l'exprime pas, il peut se montrer envers d'autres personnes, et dans certains cas, il peut se montrer avec un regard fixe
issues.advice: Source: 'And A Q himself did not say it, only when quarreling with others did he occasionally glare and say'. The translation invents 'se montrer' and loses the quarreling context. Render as 'Und A Q selbst sagte nichts; nur wenn er mit anderen stritt, sagte er bisweilen mit starrem Blick'.

issues.span: Nous avons été plus riches que toi, et tu as quoi ?
issues.advice: Source: 'We were once much richer than you! What do you amount to!' The second clause is an insult, not a question about possessions. Render as 'Wir waren früher viel reicher als du! Was bist du schon!'

issues.span: Yu-Dong
issues.advice: 未庄 is the village name Weizhuang; transliterate consistently as 'Weizhuang', not 'Yu-Dong'.

issues.span: « histoire » prématuré
issues.advice: 『行状』 is a set term for a person's life record/conduct; use 'Lebensgeschichte' or 'Vorleben' consistently, and fix gender agreement ('prématurée').

issues.span: est surtout nom et origine peu connue
issues.advice: Grammatically and stylistically broken; restructure into a proper German sentence.

issues.span: il peut se montrer envers d'autres personnes, et dans certains cas, il peut se montrer avec un regard fixe
issues.advice: Repetitive and unidiomatic; rewrite as a single coherent clause about quarreling and glaring.

issues.span: donnant des réflexions
issues.advice: This calque does not convey the Chinese 'making fun of him'; use a German idiom like 'Scherz mit ihm treiben'.

payload.translation: Bei A Q sind schon Name und Herkunft kaum bekannt, und seine frühere „Lebensgeschichte“ ist ebenfalls kaum bekannt. Sie ließen ihn nur helfen und trieben nur Scherz mit ihm. Und A Q selbst sagte nichts; nur wenn er mit anderen stritt, sagte er bisweilen mit starrem Blick: „Wir waren früher viel reicher als du! Was bist du schon!“

issues.span: Sie ließen ihn nur helfen und trieben nur Scherz mit ihm.
issues.advice: The causal clause '因为未庄的人们之于阿Q...' is dropped; the sentence loses the reason and the subject 'die Leute von Weizhuang'. Restore the causal link and the subject (e.g. 'Denn die Leute von Weizhuang...').

issues.span: kaum bekannt
issues.advice: '渺茫' here means vague/obscure/uncertain, not 'kaum bekannt' (barely known). Use a term conveying vagueness/uncertainty for both name/origin and 'Lebensgeschichte'.

issues.span: nirgends 'niemand hatte sich je um seine Lebensgeschichte gekümmert'
issues.advice: The clause '从来没有留心他的行状的' (no one ever paid attention to his 'Lebensgeschichte') is omitted; add it.

issues.span: viel reicher als du
issues.advice: '阔' means wealthy/prosperous/great, not specifically 'reicher'; consider 'viel wohlhabender/bedeutender' to match the boastful tone.

payload.translation: Bei A Q sind schon Name und Herkunft kaum bekannt, und seine frühere „Lebensgeschichte“ ist ebenfalls kaum bekannt. Denn die Leute von Weizhuang ließen ihn nur helfen und trieben nur Scherz mit ihm. issues.span: Denn die Leute von Weizhuang ließen ihn nur helfen und trieben nur Scherz mit ihm.
issues.advice: The source also states they 'never paid attention to his 行状' (never took note of his background/record). This clause is omitted; add it to preserve meaning.

issues.span: kaum bekannt
issues.advice: 渺茫 here means vague/uncertain/obscure, not 'kaum bekannt' (barely known). Use a term like 'ungewiss'/'verschwommen' to reflect vagueness rather than lack of knowledge.

issues.span: sagte er bisweilen mit starrem Blick
issues.advice: The source has 瞪着眼睛 (glaring/with staring eyes); 'mit starrem Blick' is acceptable but the sentence structure 'sagte er ... mit starrem Blick' reads slightly awkward; consider 'rief er bisweilen mit weit aufgerissenen Augen'.

payload.translation: A Q has no home and lives in the soil house of the Tuyu; he has no fixed job, only doing short labor, plowing and threshing, and rowing. When his work is long, he may live with the temporary owner, but once done, he leaves. So, people are busy, still remembering A Q, but remembering is only the work, not the "chronicle"; when idle, A Q forgets him completely, and even the "chronicle" is forgotten. Only once, there is a old man who praises: "A Q is really able to do it!" At that moment, A Q is barefoot and thin, standing before him, and others don't know whether the words are sincere or mockery, yet A Q likes it. A Q is very self-respecting, and all the residents of the village are not in his eyes.

issues.span: the soil house of the Tuyu
issues.advice: The proper noun 土谷祠 is a temple name (Tugu Shrine/Temple); 'soil house of the Tuyu' mistranslates it as a common noun phrase.

issues.span: plowing and threshing, and rowing
issues.advice: 割麦 is reaping/harvesting wheat, not plowing; 舂米 is husking/pounding rice, not threshing. Render the three tasks accurately.

issues.span: the temporary owner
issues.advice: 临时主人 means temporary employer/host, not 'owner'.

issues.span: when idle, A Q forgets him completely
issues.advice: The subject is reversed: people forget A Q, not A Q forgetting himself. Fix the referent.

issues.span: A Q is barefoot
issues.advice: 赤着膊 means bare-chested/stripped to the waist, not barefoot.

issues.span: thin, standing before him
issues.advice: 懒洋洋的瘦伶仃 conveys a languid, skinny appearance; 'lazy/languid' is omitted and the sense is flattened.

issues.span: the "chronicle"
issues.advice: 行状 here is a mock-serious term for one's life story/record; 'chronicle' is misleading—consider 'biography'/'record' with the ironic tone preserved.

issues.span: all the residents of the village are not in his eyes
issues.advice: 全不在他眼睛里 means he looks down on all of them / holds them in contempt; the literal rendering loses the idiom's meaning.

issues.span: So, people are busy, still remembering A Q
issues.advice: Awkward tense and clause structure; render the temporal sense ('when people are busy, they still remember A Q').

issues.span: there is a old man who praises
issues.advice: Article agreement error ('an old man') and tense inconsistency with the narrative.

issues.span: 未庄
issues.advice: The village name Weizhuang is left untranslated as 'the village'; consider rendering the place name for consistency.

issues.span: the Tuyu soil house
issues.advice: 土谷祠 is a temple (土地庙/谷神庙), not a 'soil house'; render as 'Tugu Temple' or 'the Tutelary God's Temple'.

issues.span: plowing and harvesting, and threshing and pounding
issues.advice: The source lists three distinct jobs: 割麦 (cutting wheat), 舂米 (pounding rice), 撑船 (punting/rowing a boat). 'Plowing' and 'threshing' are not in the source, and 撑船 is omitted.

issues.span: when idle, A Q forgets him completely
issues.advice: Subject/object reversed: people forget A Q, not A Q forgetting himself. Should be 'when idle, people forget even A Q'.

issues.span: A Q is barefoot and thin
issues.advice: 赤着膊 means bare-chested/bare-backed, not barefoot. Also 懒洋洋 (languidly) is omitted.

issues.span: the "chronicle"
issues.advice: 行状 is a formal 'biography/life account' (often ironic here); 'chronicle' is inaccurate—use 'biography' or 'life story'.

issues.span: all the villagers of the village are not in his eyes
issues.advice: 未庄 is a place name (Weizhuang); 'villagers of the village' loses it. Also the idiom means he looks down on everyone—render as 'he looked down on all the residents of Weizhuang'.

issues.span: So, people are busy, still remembering A Q
issues.advice: Awkward tense/clause structure; rephrase as 'So when people are busy they still remember A Q'.

issues.span: A Q is really able to do it!
issues.advice: Stilted; 'A Q can really work!' better captures 真能做.

payload.translation: A Q has no home and lives in the Tugu Temple; he has no fixed job, only doing short labor, plowing and harvesting, and threshing and pounding. When his work is long, he may live with the temporary employer, but once done, he leaves. So when people are busy, they still remember A Q, but remembering is only the work, not the "biography"; when idle, people forget even A Q, and the "biography" is forgotten. Only once, there is an old man who praises: "A Q is really able to do it!" At that moment, A Q is barefoot and thin, standing before him, and others don't know whether the words are sincere or mockery, yet A Q likes it. A Q is very self-respecting, and all the residents of Weizhuang are not in his eyes.

issues.span: lives in the Tugu Temple
issues.advice: The source says 土谷祠 (Temple of the Earth God and Grain God) in 未庄 (Weizhuang village). 'Tugu Temple' is a transliteration that loses meaning; consider rendering as 'Temple of the Earth God' or 'Tugu Shrine' with the village name retained.

issues.span: plowing and harvesting, and threshing and pounding
issues.advice: The source lists 割麦 (cutting wheat), 舂米 (husking/pounding rice), 撑船 (poling/rowing a boat). The translation omits 撑船 and misrenders 割麦 as 'plowing and harvesting'; render each task accurately.

issues.span: barefoot
issues.advice: 赤着膊 means 'bare-chested' (stripped to the waist), not barefoot. Correct to 'bare-chested'.

issues.span: all the residents of Weizhuang are not in his eyes
issues.advice: 全不在他眼睛里 means he looks down on / holds all the villagers in contempt. Render idiomatically, e.g. 'he looked down on every resident of Weizhuang.'

issues.span: "biography"
issues.advice: 『行状』 is a technical term for a biographical sketch/eulogy (xingzhuang). Quoting 'biography' in scare quotes is acceptable but should be explained or rendered as 'biographical sketch' to preserve the ironic allusion.

issues.span: when idle, people forget even A Q, and the "biography" is forgotten
issues.advice: The clause is awkward and repetitive; smooth the parallel structure, e.g. 'when idle, they forget A Q himself, let alone his "biography."'

issues.span: A Q is really able to do it!
issues.advice: 『阿Q真能做！』 means 'A Q can really work!' / 'A Q is a real worker!'—'able to do it' is vague and unnatural.

issues.span: At that moment, A Q is barefoot and thin, standing before him
issues.advice: The source describes A Q as 懒洋洋的瘦伶仃 (languid and skinny). The translation drops 'languid' and uses present tense inconsistently; revise to reflect both descriptors and consistent tense.

issues.span: Weizhuang
issues.advice: 未庄 is a fictional village name; a consistent romanization (Weizhuang) is fine, but the first occurrence could note it is a village to aid readers.

payload.translation: A Q aitaita en forme, a été capturé par des mèches en haut, et a été touché par quatre-vingt des mains, et les gens ont fini par avoir terminé leur devoir. A Q a pris un instant, et dans son cœur, il pensait : « Je suis finally battu par mon oncle, et la vie actuelle est vraiment différente… » Et il a également terminé son devoir. A Q a pensé à ce qu’il avait dans son cœur, et il a souvent parlé de cela, donc tous les gens qui parlent de ce qu’il a fait avec lui, savent qu’il a eu ce mérite spirituel. Et lorsqu’il est capturé par ses mèches, les gens se sont déjà fait une proposition : « A Q, c’est pas un oncle qui l’a battu, c’est l’homme qui l’a battu. L’homme l’a battu ! » A Q a fermé ses mains et ses mèches, et il a regardé : « C’est une mèche, bon ? Je suis une mèche ! »

issues.span: A Q aitaita en forme
issues.advice: The source says 阿Q在形式上打败了 (Ah Q was defeated in form/appearance), not that he 'aitaita en forme'. Render the sense of being defeated in outward form.

issues.span: a été capturé par des mèches en haut
issues.advice: 被人揪住黄辫子 means someone grabbed his yellow queue/braid; 'capturé par des mèches en haut' is wrong. Use 'on l'attrapa par sa natte jaune'.

issues.span: a été touché par quatre-vingt des mains
issues.advice: 在壁下碰了四五个响头 means he knocked his head four or five times against the wall (loud kowtows), not 'touched by eighty hands'. Render 'cogna quatre ou cinq fois sa tête contre le mur'.

issues.span: les gens ont fini par avoir terminé leur devoir
issues.advice: 闲人这才心满意足的得胜的走了 means the idlers, satisfied, left as victors. 'terminé leur devoir' is a mistranslation.

issues.span: Je suis finally battu par mon oncle
issues.advice: 我总算被儿子打了 means 'after all, I was beaten by my son'. 'mon oncle' is wrong (儿子 = son), and 'finally' is untranslated English.

issues.span: la vie actuelle est vraiment différente
issues.advice: 现在的世界真不像样 means 'the world nowadays is really outrageous/shameful', not 'different'.

issues.span: il a également terminé son devoir
issues.advice: 于是也心满意足的得胜的走了 means he too left satisfied and victorious; 'terminé son devoir' is wrong.

issues.span: tous les gens qui parlent de ce qu’il a fait avec lui
issues.advice: 凡有和阿Q玩笑的人们 means all who joked with Ah Q, not 'people who talk about what he did with him'.

issues.span: ce mérite spirituel
issues.advice: 精神上的胜利法 is the 'spiritual victory method' (his famous 'method of spiritual victory'); 'mérite spirituel' is wrong.

issues.span: les gens se sont déjà fait une proposition
issues.advice: 人就先一着对他说 means people would preemptively say to him; 'se sont fait une proposition' is wrong.

issues.span: c’est pas un oncle qui l’a battu, c’est l’homme qui l’a battu
issues.advice: 这不是儿子打老子，是人打畜生 means 'this is not a son beating his father, it's a man beating a beast'. 'oncle' and 'l'homme' are wrong; 畜生 = beast/animal.

issues.span: A Q a fermé ses mains et ses mèches, et il a regardé
issues.advice: 阿Q两只手都捏住了自己的辫根，歪着头 means he clutched the base of his queue with both hands and tilted his head; 'fermé ses mains' and 'a regardé' are wrong.

issues.span: A Q aitaita en forme
issues.advice: The opening '阿Q在形式上打败了' means Ah Q was defeated in form/appearance, not that he 'aitaita' (a non-word). Render as 'Ah Q fut vaincu en apparence' or similar.

issues.span: a été capturé par des mèches en haut
issues.advice: '被人揪住黄辫子' means someone grabbed his yellow queue/braid; 'capturé par des mèches en haut' is wrong. Use 'fut saisi par sa natte jaune'.

issues.span: a été touché par quatre ou cinq fois sa tête contre le mur
issues.advice: '在壁下碰了四五个响头' means his head was knocked against the wall four or five times with a loud sound. Translate as 'on lui cogna la tête contre le mur quatre ou cinq fois'.

issues.span: Les gens ont fini par avoir terminé leur devoir
issues.advice: '闲人这才心满意足的得胜的走了' means the idlers, satisfied, left victorious. The translation invents 'devoir'. Render as 'les oisifs, satisfaits, s'en allèrent victorieux'.

issues.span: Je suis finally battu par mon oncle
issues.advice: '我总算被儿子打了' means 'I was beaten by my son after all' — the self-deception is that the beater is his 'son', not 'oncle'. Also 'finally' is untranslated English. Use 'J'ai quand même été battu par mon fils'.

issues.span: la vie actuelle est vraiment different
issues.advice: '现在的世界真不像样' means the world nowadays is really outrageous/unseemly. 'different' is wrong and untranslated English. Use 'le monde d'aujourd'hui est vraiment scandaleux'.

issues.span: il a également terminé son devoir
issues.advice: '于是也心满意足的得胜的走了' means he too left satisfied and victorious. The 'devoir' rendering is a mistranslation.

issues.span: tous les gens qui parlent de ce qu’il a fait avec lui savent qu’il a eu ce mérite spirituel
issues.advice: '凡有和阿Q玩笑的人们，几乎全知道他有这一种精神上的胜利法' means almost all who joked with Ah Q knew of his 'spiritual victory method'. 'mérite spirituel' and 'parlent de ce qu'il a fait' are wrong; use 'presque tous ceux qui plaisantaient avec Ah Q connaissaient sa méthode de victoire spirituelle'.

issues.span: les gens se sont déjà fait une proposition
issues.advice: '人就先一着对他说' means people would preemptively say to him. Render as 'on lui disait d'avance'.

issues.span: c’est pas un oncle qui l’a battu, c’est l’homme qui l’a battu
issues.advice: '这不是儿子打老子，是人打畜生' means 'this is not a son beating his father, it's a man beating a beast'. The translation reverses and mistranslates the kinship and '畜生'. Use 'ce n'est pas un fils qui bat son père, c'est un homme qui bat une bête'.

issues.span: A Q a fermé ses mains et ses mèches, et il a regardé
issues.advice: '阿Q两只手都捏住了自己的辫根，歪着头' means Ah Q clutched the base of his queue with both hands and tilted his head. 'fermé ses mains' and 'a regardé' are wrong; use 'Ah Q saisit la racine de sa natte à deux mains et inclina la tête'.

issues.span: C’est une mèche, bon ? Je suis une mèche !
issues.advice: '打虫豸，好不好？我是虫豸' means 'Beating a worm/insect, okay? I am a worm'. '虫豸' is 'insect/worm', not 'mèche' (strand/lock). Use 'C'est une vermine qu'on bat, d'accord ? Je suis une vermine !'

payload.translation: A Q fut vaincu en apparence, fut saisi par sa natte jaune, et fut touché quatre ou cinq fois sa tête contre le mur. Les oisifs, satisfaits, s'en allèrent victorieux. A Q pensa : « J'ai quand même été battu par mon fils, et le monde d'aujourd'hui est vraiment scandaleux… » Et il s'en allait victorieux. Presque tous ceux qui plaisantaient avec Ah Q connaissaient sa méthode de victoire spirituelle. Il disait d'avance : « Ce n'est pas un fils qui bat son père, c'est un homme qui bat une bête. » Ah Q saisit la racine de sa natte à deux mains et inclina la tête. C'est une vermine qu'on bat, d'accord ? Je suis une vermine !

issues.span: A Q pensa : « J'ai quand même été battu par mon fils, et le monde d'aujourd'hui est vraiment scandaleux… » Et il s'en allait victorieux.
issues.advice: The source says 阿Q站了一刻 (Ah Q stood for a moment) before thinking, and 于是也心满意足的得胜的走了 (then also went off satisfied and victorious). The translation omits the standing-for-a-moment detail and the 'also/satisfied' nuance, and uses 's'en allait' (imperfect) instead of a completed action.

issues.span: Il disait d'avance : « Ce n'est pas un fils qui bat son père, c'est un homme qui bat une bête. »
issues.advice: The source says 此后每逢揪住他黄辫子的时候，人就先一着对他说 (thereafter, whenever they grabbed his yellow braid, people would preemptively say to him). The translation omits the conditional 'whenever they grabbed his braid' and the subject 'people', and misattributes the speech to Ah Q ('Il disait').
